name: TPB
title: Avengers Disassembled: Thor #1
desc:
The end is nigh for the gods of Asgard,and only Thor and his Avengers allies might be able to stave off the fate - but will the Thunder God be Asgard's savior or the architect of it's downfall?

Beset on all sides by treacherous foes from his past,the God of Thunder leads the tattered remnants of the forces of Asgard on a desperate quest,as the Realm Retinal Burns. In search of new wisdom Thor must repeat the ordeals of Odin and the price may be to terrible for even an immortal to play!

Collecting Thor # 80-85,written by Mike Avon Oeming and illustrated by Andrea Divito.
